title: Structures and stability of N11 cluster

species.source_note: Fig. 1 (structures 1-3), Section 3 discussion -- bond distances/angles given only in figure images (not read in this pass, proof-formatting made this PDF's text extraction messy)
species.notes: Topology: two aromatic pentazole (5-membered) rings connected -- THERMODYNAMICALLY MOST STABLE of the 8 isomers. Explicitly flagged by authors as 'kinetically unstable' despite being the lowest-energy isomer: decomposition barrier only 5.6 kcal/mol at B3LYP/6-31G* (17.0 HF, 8.0 B3PW91) -- low kinetic stability, good example for the kinetic-vs-thermodynamic stability distinction. All bond lengths reported to lie in range 1.27-1.39 A (Fig. 1, not individually transcribed here).
